Title: 488469-2026: Italy – Engineering services – “SPORT E PERIFERIE 2025” ISSUED BY THE PRESIDENCY OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS - DEPARTMENT FOR SPORT, “CONSTRUCTION OF NEW MULTIFUNCTIONAL SPORTS ARENAS” NEW SPORTS ARENA IN VIA UGO FOSCOLO - AWARD OF TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE AND ENGINEERING SERVICES FOR DRAFTING THE PFTE, D.L. CSP AND CSE. CUP E85B25000310005.
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a multifunctional sports hall corresponds to sbp’s interest in long-span structures and complex buildings with significant structural and engineering requirements. Project in Italy (outside DACH) slightly reduces the priority but remains highly relevant.
titel: New construction of a multifunctional sports arena in Via Ugo Foscolo – award of architecture and engineering services
kurzbeschreibung: In Capurso (Bari), a new multifunctional Palazzetto dello Sport is being built under the "Sport e Periferie 2025" programme. The technical architecture and engineering services for design and construction supervision were tendered and have now been awarded.
wettbewerb_art: Award of architecture and engineering services (open procedure, not a classic architectural competition)
gewinner_rolle: Architecture and engineering team (design services including construction supervision and safety coordination)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract amount for design services: 436546.83 EUR (excluding VAT)
projektbeteiligte:
UNIONE DEI COMUNI MONTEDORO - COMUNE CAPURSO – public contracting authority
RT DE8 ARCHITETTI – winner, architecture and engineering services (PFTE, construction management D.L., safety coordination CSP/CSE)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Sports building (Palazzetto dello Sport) generally within sbp’s focus
- Likely roof and hall structure with medium span, potentially interesting
- Project volume rather medium-sized and outside DACH, therefore limited strategic relevance
- Structural design is part of the awarded engineering services, cooperation only realistically possible in a supplementary role
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in Italy, checking engineer services according to the German model not directly applicable
- No indication of a separate tender for checking or control statics
- Medium-sized project, but no major project with identifiable international checking requirements
baukosten_erklaerung: No information on construction costs; based on the fee (approx. 606 thousand EUR estimated), the construction sum cannot be reliably derived without further information.
naechste_schritte: No active approach required. Only monitor the project. If contacts in Italy (Bari/Apulia region) exist, note RT DE8 ARCHITETTI as a potential partner for future sports or hall projects (address: via Piacenza 31, 26013 Crema, Italy).
notes: Scope of services: technical architecture and engineering services for PFTE (preliminary design/feasibility stage), construction management (D.L.), safety coordination in design and execution phases (CSP/CSE). Structural design is very likely included in the awarded package, therefore not a classic architectural competition with structural design still open. Award criteria in the TED text unclear (quality/technical offer mentioned, weighting not clearly specified).
